learner_operation: Identify h(x) and the complete g(y) in dy/dx=h(x)g(y), take 1/g(y), and select the equivalent separated equation A(y)dy/dx=B(x); do not integrate.

fixed_features.feature: One equation, one radio field and five equations with a unique correct selection.
fixed_features.justification: All ten captured practice sources use this response contract; tutorial 6767 defines the target equation.

fixed_features.feature: Stop after factorization and reciprocal transfer.
fixed_features.justification: KP source prompts ask to separate variables; general solutions belong to later tutorial/prerequisite content.

fixed_features.feature: Small positive scalar parameters, quotient powers 1–4 and positive even radical powers 2/4.
fixed_features.justification: Conservative easy workload with the source factor types; even powers plus positive constants keep radical domain real. These bounds do not fix which candidate row is correct.

fixed_features.feature: A(y) beside dy/dx and B(x) on the right.
fixed_features.justification: Essential instructional convention explicitly defined in tutorial 6767, not merely the arrangement of one example.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Numerator dependent factors require reciprocals; denominator dependent factors require direct multipliers.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Positions have no mathematical status; banks may use plausible wrong powers and role exchange.
